title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:


Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
Network Automation Engineer


We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and automate large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructure. This role blends deep network engineering expertise with modern automation and software development practices. You will work on high-availability internet and backbone networks, translating complex network designs into repeatable, programmatic templates and workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain carrier-grade network infrastructure supporting internet and backbone services
  • Engineer and support Cisco IOS XR–based platforms in production environments
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python scripting
  • Translate network designs, configurations, and standards into programmatic templates (Jinja2)
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management of network devices
  • Design and support VPN architectures and products, including troubleshooting and optimisation
  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance across large-scale networks
  • Participate in network design reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong background in network engineering and design
  • Hands-on experience with carrier-grade networks and internet infrastructure
  • Deep knowledge of Cisco IOS XR (configuration, troubleshooting, and operations)
  • Solid understanding of VPN technologies and products
  • Python scripting for network automation and tooling
  • Experience creating and managing Jinja2 templates for network configuration

title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote


Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.


Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system


Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred


Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification


Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

• Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience with PLM

• Technical expertise with PLM systems such as CAD, PDM, ERP, PMO

• Excellent communication (oral and written) skills, including the ability to explain and present technical information

• Effectively train and advise users on information technology issues

• Prepare written documentation in a clear and concise style

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment and take the initiative to learn new tools and concepts quickly

• Creative thinker with attention to detail, strong analytical, multitasking, and interpersonal skills

• Approachable and adaptable

• Ability to work extended-hours or outside of normal business hours including weekends as needed

• Skills in MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)

• Must have working-level knowledge of the English language, including reading, writing, and speaking English


Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience in a factory environment desirable

• Technical experience with database management & language (SQL, Oracle)

• Able to work independently and in a team environment, as well as with cross-functional groups

• Resilient, self-motived and able to work well under pressure

title: Data Analyst
description:
Descrição da Função


Esta é uma função remota em tempo integral para Analista de Dados . O Analista de Dados será responsável por coletar, organizar, analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências. A coleta ocorrerá em bancos de dados próprios bem como a busca de dados em bases externas, de forma automatizada e também de forma manual (que pode vir a ser automatizada, fazendo parte da função). Também irá desenvolver e manter painéis de dados (dashboards), criar modelos de dados e auxiliar na melhoria dos processos de tomada de decisão do negócio, alimentar e criar planilhas. Além disso, a função inclui a preparação de relatórios e a apresentação clara de insights para as partes interessadas.

Qualificações

  • Proficiência em Análise de Dados e compreensão abrangente do trabalho com grandes volumes de dados
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de identificar tendências e insights acionáveis
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Estatística para analisar dados e gerar conclusões precisas
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para apresentar insights e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados e criação de visualizações eficazes
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e softwares estatísticos como SQL, Python, R é desejável
  • Conhecimento em Excel avançado é necessário
  • Conhecimento básico de Ingles é necessário.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente remoto em tempo integral
  • Graduação em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada é altamente desejável

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java e Agentes de IA II
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java com experiência em engenharia de software, mentalidade DevOps e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções com agentes de IA, automação inteligente e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs), no projeto BSS, do ICC SOFT.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e aplicações em Java, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Construir, testar e implantar agentes de IA para automação de processos de negócio;
  • Integrar LLMs com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços externos e ferramentas corporativas;
  • Contribuir para pipelines de RAG, mecanismos de memória e recuperação eficiente de contexto;
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos fluxos envolvendo agentes de IA e automações inteligentes;
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, integração e funcionais);
  • Escrever testes específicos para componentes agentic AI;
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD para build, teste e deploy contínuo;
  • Utilizar conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) para implantações;
  • Assegurar observabilidade e monitoramento de workflows agentic AI;
  • Participar de code reviews, sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e atuar como referência para demandas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Revisar e manter documentação detalhada de arquitetura, componentes, integrações e processos de deploy;
  • Registrar decisões técnicas e padrões adotados para uso de IA e automação.



Requisitos e qualificações

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: UX/UI DESIGN
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.

A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.

● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.

● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.

● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.

● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.

● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;

  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;

Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;

  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;

  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Freelance Photographer
description:
We are seeking skilled and reliable freelance photographers to support an upcoming visual content initiative. This role involves capturing a small set of high-quality images following a general creative brief. Photographers may work with models or self-shoot, depending on preference and availability.

This is a great opportunity for photographers looking to take on flexible contract work, build their portfolio, or collaborate on a unique project.

About the Role

Photographers will be responsible for producing a series of clear, well-lit images that meet the project’s technical and creative guidelines. The work can be completed at your preferred location, using your own equipment. 

No specialized gear is required; modern smartphones or standard photography equipment are both acceptable as long as they meet basic quality expectations. 

Responsabilities

  • Capture a small set of photos following a simple creative brief
  • Ensure images are well-composed and meet general quality standards
  • Work independently and deliver files within the requested timeframe
  • Communicate promptly and professionally throughout the project
  • Provide all required files and any accompanying forms upon completion

Qualifications

  • Experience in photography (professional or amateur)
  • Ability to capture clear, high-quality images
  • Reliable communication and attention to detail
  • Access to a smartphone or camera capable of producing sharp, well-lit photos

Compensation

A competitive payment is provided based on the number of approved submissions. Payments are made once a month. 

How to apply

Please send your portfolios or examples of photography to

Senior SAP ABAP Developer (IBP / Finance Focus)

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

A BR Media Group é um hub de conteúdo referência no mercado para a economia de criadores , com um forte mindset data-driven , liderando soluções de influência e conteúdo para algumas das maiores marcas do mundo.

  • Vivência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.);

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes.   • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Integrações Java , com experiência sólida em APIs e API Gateway Sensedia , para atuar em projetos estratégicos junto a grandes empresas.


Esse profissional será responsável por desenhar, desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações , garantindo segurança, governança, performance e escalabilidade, trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares (produto, arquitetura, design e gestão).


Buscamos alguém com forte visão técnica, orientação a qualidade e que se sinta confortável em ambientes corporativos complexos e orientados a APIs.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Java 8 e acima : Forte domínio da linguagem, incluindo boas práticas, performance e recursos modernos da plataforma;
  • Spring Boot : Criação e manutenção de APIs e serviços de integração, preferencialmente em arquiteturas de microserviços;
  • Integrações e APIs REST: Design, implementação, versionamento e documentação de APIs RESTful. Além disso, conhecimento de padrões de integração (sync/async, idempotência, retries, timeouts);
  • API Gateway Sensedia: Experiência prática com publicação e gerenciamento de APIs no Sensedia, configuração de policies (segurança, rate limit, quotas, CORS, transformação de payloads), autenticação e autorização (OAuth2, JWT, API Keys), monitoramento, métricas e governança de APIs e versionamento e ciclo de vida de APIs no gateway;
  • Testes automatizados: Testes unitários com JUnit e Mockito;
  • Persistência de dados: JPA/Hibernate e conceitos de ORM;
  • Controle de versão: Git (branching, merge, code review);
  • Ambiente Linux;
  • Conceitos de DDD.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD);
  • Maven;
  • Arquitetura de Microsserviços;
  • Design Patterns aplicados a integrações;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos com alto volume de APIs.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We're looking for a Data Analytics & Engineering Specialist in Brazil!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


About the Role

We are looking for a gritty problem solver and self-starter who will serve as a key interface between the Analytics and Engineering teams. In this role, you will deeply understand the needs of analytics stakeholders, anticipate future requirements, and partner closely with Data Engineers to identify, vet, and prioritize upstream data. Your mission is to enable strong analytical capabilities, drive operational excellence, and improve efficiency across data partnerships.


What You’ll Do

  • Rationalize and prioritize data requests, designing ideal and scalable solutions.
  • Execute new data flows and maintain existing pipelines on a daily basis.
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, efficient data pipelines that support multiple use cases with minimal incremental effort.
  • Drive the vision for Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Warehousing across all business lines, defining and executing a roadmap to achieve that vision.
  • Evolve analytical data ecosystems to support advanced analytics and big data use cases.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in analytics and data engineering.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with big data processing systems such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or similar technologies.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • Proven ability to design and lead time-sensitive, strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, and presentation of insights and recommendations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related area).
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux shell scripting and Python.
  • Strong database performance tuning and optimization skills.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or related field preferred.

title: Senior Tax Consultant
description:

Local: 100% Remoto


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte funcional das soluções fiscais Tax One e DFE , analisando e resolvendo tickets relacionados a obrigações fiscais.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs , assegurando qualidade e prazos nas entregas.

  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação fiscal brasileira .

  • Vivência prática com documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NFS-e, CT-e, MDF-e, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com times de TI e negócio.
  • Inglês obrigatório.


Interessados enviar CV, disponibilidade e rate para ou aplicar diretamente.
